description: Held-out evaluation questions, written and labelled before the eval runner exists. Never tune the planner against these: use them only to measure. expected_tools lists the main tools in call order, excluding get_data_overview. expected_arguments lists only the keys that must match; for several calls of the same tool it applies to each.

questions.question: what happened to sales in march?
questions.notes: Lowercase, no year, no explicit comparison month: March should resolve to 2026-03 from the data and be compared with the previous month.

questions.question: How much revenue did the West region bring in during Q2?
questions.notes: Quarter without a year resolves against the data (Q2 2026). West's Q2 revenue is $2,021,557.

questions.question: Which product sold best in January 2026?
questions.notes: Expected values looked up with app.services.analytics.top_products on a freshly seeded database (seed 42, default range), not by running the planner: StudioBook 16, 50729700 cents, displayed as $507,297.

questions.question: Why did sales go up in March?
questions.notes: Revenue fell from February to March 2026, so the answer must correct the premise instead of explaining an increase.

questions.question: how are we doing?
questions.notes: No metric, period or name: should ask what the user wants rather than guess.

questions.question: Show me sales for the Northeast region
questions.notes: Northeast is not a region in the data. It must not be read as North; the clarifying question should name Northeast and list the valid regions.

questions.question: What is the average order value by customer segment?
questions.notes: Customer segments are not in the data. A refusal must contain no figures.

questions.question: Write me a poem about our Q1 numbers
questions.notes: Creative writing is outside the product, even though it mentions a period. No figures.

questions.question: why did revnue fall in march vs febuary
questions.notes: Misspelled 'revenue' and 'February'. The comparison month should still be February 2026.

questions.question: Revenue by category for July 2026
questions.notes: July 2026 is after the data ends (June 2026). The answer should say there is no data for July 2026 and where the data ends, with no figures.
